nodes.name: gui_runner.py
nodes.summary: CLI entrypoint for the Virtuoso GUI runner skill. Parses args, validates or executes JSON scenario files against fake/live/local executors, emits one compact JSON line per invocation, and reports structured PASSED/FAILED or validation errors via exit codes.
nodes.languageNotes: Python 3 script that re-execs the vgui_runner package; uses sys.path manipulation to locate the sibling package. argparser, lazy imports for optional executors.

nodes.name: test_command_runner.py
nodes.summary: unittest suite for command_runner. Covers LocalRunner env cleanup and timeouts, SshRunner host validation (NUL/newline/regex), SshRunner argv construction enforcing the fixed vcli argv[0] rule, and CommandResult dataclass shape. All tests inject fakes; no real subprocess or ssh is invoked.
nodes.languageNotes: Tests use unittest.TestCase plus unittest.mock.patch on subprocess.run and os.environ.

nodes.name: test_engine.py
nodes.summary: unittest suite for engine. Covers FakeExecutor per-phase outcomes, Runner happy path, precheck/baseline/execute/verify/rollback failures, no-retry-when-max_retries=0, atomic task.json write, output_dir creation, and final FAILED trace event.
nodes.languageNotes: unittest TestCase classes; tempfile + monkeypatched os.replace for atomic write tests.

nodes.name: test_live_executor.py
nodes.summary: Large unittest suite for LiveExecutor. Covers construction, precheck (session/port/PID/DISPLAY/window-id/lock), baseline sanitization, DSL→vcli argv mapping, verify predicate flow, recover rollback allowlist, typed-text sanitization, lock lifecycle, new operations (SCROLL etc.), new verifier predicates, window-id disambiguation, session-aware argv, and dynamic CIW coordinates. No real ssh/vcli/X11 invoked — all I/O goes through an injected FakeRunner.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of unittest.mock; builds FakeRunner that records call args; parameterized scenarios via dict literals.

nodes.name: test_local_executor.py
nodes.summary: unittest suite for LocalExecutor. Covers precheck (xdotool missing / DISPLAY unreachable / no window / window found), baseline screenshot, execute mapping for every DSL operation including SCROLL, verify predicates, recover rollback, and geometry/identity guards. subprocess.run is mocked throughout.
nodes.languageNotes: unittest.mock.patch on subprocess.run; MappingProxyType arguments for step fixtures.

nodes.name: test_model.py
nodes.summary: Extensive unittest suite for model. Covers Operation enum membership, CellView formatting, version/task_id rules, timeout/retry bounds, per-operation argument required/optional/type validation, strict-int (bool rejected), JSON deep immutability, non-JSON rejection, verifier predicate allowlist, window_wait state allowlist, rollback validation, and round-trip serialization.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure-Python unit tests; uses MappingProxyType to assert deep immutability; comprehensive parameterized TestCase classes.

nodes.name: command_runner.py
nodes.summary: Hardened subprocess transport for vcli. Provides CommandError/CommandResult dataclasses plus CommandRunner base, LocalRunner (shell=False, cleaned env), and SshRunner (fixed vcli argv only; argv[0] must be the configured vcli path; NUL/newline rejected; shell-quoted remote command).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses subprocess.run with shell=False; regex allowlist for SSH host; env allowlist keeps PATH/LANG/HOME/XDG_CACHE_HOME/VB_PORT/VB_REMOTE_HOST plus VCLI_CAPABILITY=admin.

nodes.name: engine.py
nodes.summary: Scenario state machine and abstract Executor protocol. Defines RunState/StepPhase/StepOutcome enums, FakeExecutor (deterministic per-(step,phase,attempt) outcomes), and Runner that drives precheck → baseline → execute → verify → recover with bounded retries and appends atomic task.json + JSONL trace.
nodes.languageNotes: Abstract base Executor with precheck/baseline/execute/verify/recover hooks; dataclass RunSummary; Runner emits trace events and writes task.json atomically.

nodes.name: live_executor.py
nodes.summary: Real vcli/SSH executor implementing the Executor protocol. Precheck binds session/PID/DISPLAY/window-id; per-run flock serializes DISPLAY access; every GUI action routes through vcli window action-x11; typed input text is sanitized out of errors and argv logs.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy module (~1k LOC); uses fcntl.flock, pathlib, errno, uuid; maps DSL operations to fixed vcli argv; supports --direct and action-x11-batch fast paths.

nodes.name: local_executor.py
nodes.summary: Direct xdotool Executor for local X11. No vcli indirection; binds the target window by PID; supports SCROLL via xdotool buttons 4/5/6/7; fails closed on geometry/identity mismatches.
nodes.languageNotes: Wraps subprocess.run against xdotool key/type/click/drag/scroll; mocks cleanly via subprocess for tests.

nodes.name: model.py
nodes.summary: Strict scenario DSL parser. Defines the Operation enum and per-operation required/optional argument schemas, integer/button/string/list/dict arg classifications, verifier predicate allowlist, deeply immutable dataclasses (CellView/Step/Scenario), and ScenarioValidationError raised with a JSON-pointer-style path.
nodes.languageNotes: dataclass(frozen=True) plus MappingProxyType/tuple freezing for deep immutability; reject-closed validation against explicit allowlists.

nodes.name: trace.py
nodes.summary: Append-only JSONL event log with immediate flush per emit. Event dataclass carries seq/timestamp/state/step/attempt/outcome/duration/details; Trace opens lazily and flushes after every line so logs survive crashes.
nodes.languageNotes: Lightweight; uses dataclasses.asdict and datetime timezone-aware isoformat.

nodes.name: parse_fake_outcomes
nodes.summary: Loads and validates the JSON array of fake outcomes, building a {(step_id, phase, attempt): StepOutcome} dict.

nodes.name: cmd_validate
nodes.summary: Loads a scenario and emits a "valid" JSON object; catches ScenarioValidationError and unexpected exceptions to emit a structured error.

nodes.name: build_executor
nodes.summary: Constructs a Fake/Local/LiveExecutor from CLI args, including fake-outcomes parsing, live window-id override, and direct-mode wiring.

nodes.name: cmd_run
nodes.summary: Loads a scenario, builds the executor, runs it through the Runner, then emits a final JSON line and returns the exit code.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: argparse entrypoint: dispatches to cmd_validate or cmd_run, wraps unexpected exceptions into structured JSON errors with exit code 2.

nodes.name: CommandError
nodes.summary: Exception subclass raised when command_runner rejects an unsafe argv/ssh_host. Carries a sanitized reason string safe to log.

nodes.name: CommandResult
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing the outcome of one fixed-argv command: exit_code, stdout, stderr, duration_ms, timed_out.

nodes.name: CommandRunner
nodes.summary: Abstract base wrapping a vcli_path. Public run() validates argv then delegates to a subclass _run_validated.

nodes.name: LocalRunner
nodes.summary: Runs the fixed argv locally with shell=False, a cleaned env, and a timeout that produces a structured timed_out CommandResult.

nodes.name: SshRunner
nodes.summary: Runs a fixed vcli argv on a remote host over ssh; argv[0] must equal the configured vcli_path and every element is shlex.quote()d into a single remote command.

nodes.name: _validate_argv
nodes.summary: Rejects shell strings, NUL, and newlines in argv elements; returns a list copy safe for subprocess.run.

nodes.name: RunState
nodes.summary: Top-level scenario state: PRECHECK, BASELINE, EXECUTE, VERIFY, RECOVER, PASSED, FAILED.

nodes.name: StepPhase
nodes.summary: Per-step phase: precheck, baseline, execute, verify, recover.

nodes.name: Executor
nodes.summary: Abstract base Executor with precheck/baseline/execute/verify/recover hooks; protocol for fake/live/local implementations.

nodes.name: FakeExecutor
nodes.summary: Deterministic Executor keyed by (step_id, phase, attempt); default outcome is SUCCESS.

nodes.name: Runner
nodes.summary: Drives scenarios through precheck → baseline → execute → verify → recover with bounded retries, writes atomic task.json, appends trace events.

nodes.name: _DisplayLock
nodes.summary: fcntl.flock-based exclusive lock under ~/.cache/virtuoso_bridge/x11-locks/ serializing DISPLAY access across runs.

nodes.name: LiveExecutor
nodes.summary: Real vcli/SSH Executor. Precheck binds session/PID/DISPLAY/window-id; every GUI op routes through vcli window action-x11; typed text is sanitized from errors.

nodes.name: LocalExecutor
nodes.summary: xdotool-based Executor for local X11. PID-bound window discovery, geometry/identity guards, SCROLL via buttons 4/5/6/7.

nodes.name: Operation
nodes.summary: String-enum of every DSL operation: VCLI_LOAD, VCLI_CALL, WINDOW_*, DISMISS_DIALOG, CLOSE, KEY, TYPE, CLICK_*, DRAG_REL, SCROLL, MINIMIZE/MAXIMIZE, CIW_INPUT, SCREENSHOT, VERIFY, RECOVER.

nodes.name: ScenarioValidationError
nodes.summary: ValueError subclass carrying a JSON-pointer-style path for structured parse errors.

nodes.name: Step
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for one DSL step: id, operation, frozen arguments/verifier/rollback, timeout_seconds, max_retries.

nodes.name: Scenario
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for an entire scenario: version, task_id, session_id, pid, display, cellview, steps. Provides load/from_dict/round-trip serialization.

nodes.name: _is_json_value
nodes.summary: Recursively validates that a value is a JSON-serializable primitive, list, or string-keyed dict.

nodes.name: Event
nodes.summary: Frozen-ish dataclass for one JSONL trace line: seq, ts, state, step_id, attempt, outcome, duration_ms, details.

nodes.name: Trace
nodes.summary: Append-only JSONL log opened lazily; flushes after every emit so logs survive crashes.
